items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And there’s Stephane Grappelli, you know, Frenchman... [INTERVIEWEE] But isn’t Grappelli Italian? It’s an Italian name.

ctx.x: the symphony but he can’t be far away, he wouldn’t even get in the front door. Oh, Joe Venuti. Can’t speak high enough of poor Joe Venuti. And there’s Stephane Grappelli, you know, Frenchman. You take those two guys, they both play just like their personality, in fact Stephane, he can play a lot of notes and he’s slipping and sliding, and he goes around on his tiptoes. He’s still alive though. But Joe Venuti played like an Italian.
But isn’t Grappelli Italian? It’s an Italian name.
